title: bingo
description: Every christmas we play bingo, this allows to have all the numbers shown in a huge TV, instead of screaming the numbers. Along with a few cool features like Light and Dark mode along with ring when a number is selected, and auto draw numbers and leaderboard.

title: battleship
description: Me and my wife like to play battleship togetter, we bought a kids toy to play it, but was not very good, so why not build a digital one for anyone who wanna play it.

title: split-pro
description: Open source alternative to Splitwise. This is not a project of my own. I support it to bring European Portuguese to the platform.

title: ckeyboard
description: I worked in a company where I had the need to have a js custom keyboard layout for any situation, if the layout was made of Emojis.

title: pycpanel
description: I develop this in a time where update a DNS record with my home network address was a mandatory thing. Today we have more technology like Reverse Proxies accessible to everyone.
